evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies JSON-RPC argument handling and functionality in src/rpc/mining.cpp and src/rpc/client.cpp.
rationale: Extends `generateblock` to accept multiple coinbase outputs and optional transactions based on an external testing request. SuperTestnet asked for multi-output coinbase capabilities to simulate pool payout protocols like Ocean and Braidpool without manual block construction workarounds, providing clear value for regtest developers.
